description:
LeadJourney connects your marketing tracking to ChatGPT so you can ask plain-language questions about where your leads come from and what's working.

Ask ChatGPT to:
• Show which traffic channels, campaigns, or ad creatives are generating leads
• Trace a single lead's journey from first touch to conversion
• Run traffic, campaign, and creative performance reports for any date range
• Build UTM-tagged links and short links for new campaigns
• Manage tags, tracking domains, and custom traffic channels
• Create and update dashboards and reports

LeadJourney works with the tracking script installed on your website and the lead data already in your workspace. Connect with your existing LeadJourney account; ChatGPT only accesses the workspaces you authorize. ChatGPT only creates or changes links, tags, channels, and dashboards when you ask it to.

Requires a LeadJourney account.

defaultPrompt: Which traffic channels brought in the most leads in the last 30 days?
Show my top campaigns by leads in the last 30 days.
